ar.title: اشتري الآن وافع لاحقًا في موسم العطلات هذا: هل هو وسيلة للراحة أم فخ للديون؟

segments.src: Holiday shopping has a new checkout option.
segments.tr: تتميز تسوق العطلات بخيار دفع جديد.

segments.src: Instead of paying the full price of a gift up front, millions of shoppers now split purchases into a handful of smaller payments.
segments.tr: بدلاً من دفع السعر الكامل للهدية مقدماً، يقوم ملايين المتسوقين الآن بتقسيم المشتريات إلى عدد قليل من الدفعات الأصغر.

segments.src: These "buy now, pay later" (BNPL) plans are popular, quick to set up, and often advertised as interest-free.
segments.tr: تعتبر خطط "اشتري الآن وافع لاحقًا" (BNPL) شائعة، وسريعة الإعداد، وغالبًا ما يتم الإعلان عنها بدون فوائد.

segments.src: They are also drawing closer attention from regulators, consumer advocates, and financial researchers.
segments.tr: كما أنها تجذب اهتمامًا أوثق من المنظمين ومدافعي المستهلكين والباحثين الماليين.

segments.src: This explainer covers how the plans work, what they can cost, and what the trend could mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: يغطي هذا التقرير كيفية عمل هذه الخطط، وما يمكن أن تكلفه، وما يمكن أن يعنيه هذا الاتجاه لميزانيات الأسر.

segments.src: ## What Is Buy Now, Pay Later?
segments.tr: ## ما هو نظام اشتري الآن وافع لاحقًا؟

segments.src: BNPL is a form of short-term financing offered at online checkout or in stores.
segments.tr: يُعد نظام BNPL شكلًا من أشكال التمويل قصير الأجل المقدم عند الدفع عبر الإنترنت أو في المتاجر.

segments.src: A shopper picks the plan, completes a quick eligibility check, and receives the item right away.
segments.tr: يختار المتسوق الخطة، ويُكمل فحصًا سريعًا للأهلية، ويستلم العنصر على الفور.

segments.src: The cost is then spread over several installments.
segments.tr: ثم يتم توزيع التكلفة على عدة أقساط.

segments.src: The most common structure is the "pay in four" plan:
segments.tr: الهيكل الأكثر شيوعًا هو خطة "الدفع على أربع دفعات":

segments.src: - **25% is paid at checkout.**
segments.tr: - **يتم دفع 25% عند إتمام الشراء.**

segments.src: - **The remaining three payments are due every two weeks**, usually charged automatically to a debit card, credit card, or bank account.
segments.tr: - **الدفعات الثلاث المتبقية مستحقة كل أسبوعين**، وعادةً ما يتم خصمها تلقائيًا من بطاقة الخصم، أو بطاقة الائتمان، أو الحساب المصرفي.

segments.src: - **No interest is charged** if every payment is made on time.
segments.tr: - **لا يتم فرض أي فوائد** إذا تم دفع كل دفعة في موعدها.

segments.src: Longer plans also exist, typically for bigger purchases.
segments.tr: توجد أيضًا خطط أطول، وعادة ما تكون للمشتريات الأكبر.

segments.src: They run from several months to a few years and often carry interest.
segments.tr: وهي تمتد من عدة أشهر إلى بضع سنوات وغالبًا ما تحمل فوائد.

segments.src: Rates vary widely by lender and by the shopper's credit profile.
segments.tr: تتفاوت المعدلات بشكل كبير حسب المقرض والملف الائتماني للمتسوق.

segments.src: ## Why the Plans Are So Popular
segments.tr: ## لماذا تحظى هذه الخطط بشعبية كبيرة

segments.src: Several things make BNPL appealing, especially during the holidays:
segments.tr: عدة أمور تجعل نظام BNPL جذابًا، خاصة خلال العطلات:

segments.src: 1. **Speed.** Approval often takes seconds and may not require a traditional credit application.
segments.tr: 1. **السرعة.** غالبًا ما تستغرق الموافقة ثوانٍ وقد لا تتطلب طلب ائتمان تقليديًا.

segments.src: 2. **Predictability.** Fixed payment amounts are easier to plan around than a revolving credit card balance.
segments.tr: 2. **القدرة على التنبؤ.** من السهل التخطيط لمبالغ الدفع الثابتة مقارنة برصيد بطاقة الائتمان المتجدد.

segments.src: 3. **Accessibility.** People with limited or no credit history may qualify when they would not for a card.
segments.tr: 3. **إمكانية الوصول.** قد يكون الأشخاص الذين لديهم تاريخ ائتماني محدود أو معدوم مؤهلين بينما لا يحق لهم الحصول على بطاقة.

segments.src: 4. **Perceived cost.** A $200 gift feels more manageable as four payments of $50.
segments.tr: 4. **التكلفة المتصورة.** تبدو هدية بقيمة 200 دولار أكثر سهولة كأربع دفعات بقيمة 50 دولارًا.

segments.src: Retail surveys in recent years have found that a growing share of consumers use BNPL during peak shopping periods.
segments.tr: وجدت استطلاعات التجزئة في السنوات الأخيرة أن نسبة متزايدة من المستهلكين يستخدمون BNPL خلال ذروة فترات التسوق.

segments.src: Online retailers report that offering installment options can raise conversion rates and the average size of an order.
segments.tr: يفيد تجار التجزئة عبر الإنترنت أن تقديم خيارات الأقساط يمكن أن يرفع معدلات التحويل ومتوسط حجم الطلب.

segments.src: ## How the Companies Make Money
segments.tr: ## كيف تكسب الشركات المال

segments.src: "Interest-free" does not mean the lender earns nothing.
segments.tr: "بدون فوائد" لا تعني أن المقرض لا يكسب شيئًا.

segments.src: BNPL providers typically make money in several ways:
segments.tr: عادة ما يكسب مقدمو خدمات BNPL المال بعدة طرق:

segments.src: - **Merchant fees.** Retailers usually pay the lender a percentage of each sale, often higher than standard card processing fees.
segments.tr: - **رسوم التجار.** عادة ما يدفع تجار التجزئة للمقرض نسبة مئوية من كل عملية بيع، وغالبًا ما تكون أعلى من رسوم معالجة البطاقات القياسية.

segments.src: - **Interest on longer loans.** Plans that stretch beyond a few installments may charge interest.
segments.tr: - **الفوائد على القروض الأطول.** الخطط التي تمتد إلى ما بعد عدة أقساط قد تفرض فوائد.

segments.src: - **Late fees.** Some providers charge a fee when a payment is missed. Others cap fees or have moved away from them.
segments.tr: - **رسوم التأخير.** يفرض بعض المزودين رسومًا عند تفويت الدفع. والبعض الآخر يضع حدًا أقصى للرسوم أو ابتعد عنها.

segments.src: - **Partnerships and other services.** Some companies also earn revenue through card programs, interchange income, and advertising.
segments.tr: - **الشراكات والخدمات الأخرى.** تكسب بعض الشركات أيضًا إيرادات من خلال برامج البطاقات، ودخل التبادل، والإعلانات.

segments.src: Because the model depends in part on sales volume, critics argue that it can encourage people to spend more than they otherwise would.
segments.tr: نظرًا لأن النموذج يعتمد جزئيًا على حجم المبيعات، يجادل النقاد بأنه يمكن أن يشجع الناس على الإنفاق أكثر مما يفعلون لولا ذلك.

segments.src: Supporters respond that it gives consumers a transparent, fixed-cost alternative to credit cards.
segments.tr: ويرد المؤيدون بأنه يمنح المستهلكين بديلًا شفافًا وثابت التكلفة لبطاقات الائتمان.

segments.src: ## What Can Go Wrong
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يمكن أن يخطئ

segments.src: BNPL is not automatically harmful.
segments.tr: نظام BNPL ليس ضارًا بطبيعته.

segments.src: Used carefully for a planned purchase, it can be a useful cash-flow tool.
segments.tr: إذا تم استخدامه بحذر لشراء مخطط له، يمكن أن يكون أداة مفيدة للتدفق النقدي.

segments.src: The risks tend to come from how people use it.
segments.tr: تميل المخاطر إلى القدوم من كيفية استخدام الناس له.

segments.src: **Stacking.** Because each plan is small, shoppers can open several at once across different retailers and apps.
segments.tr: **التراكم.** نظرًا لأن كل خط يمكن أن يكون صغيرًا، يمكن للمتسوقين فتح عدة خطط في وقت واحد عبر مختلف تجار التجزئة والتطبيقات.

segments.src: Total obligations can grow without the user noticing, and each lender may see only its own loan.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تنمو الالتزامات الإجمالية دون أن يلاحظ المستخدم، وقد يرى كل مقرض قرضه الخاص فقط.

segments.src: **Overdrafts and failed payments.** Automatic withdrawals can collide with other bills.
segments.tr: **السحب على المكشوف والدفعات الفاشلة.** يمكن أن تتداخل عمليات السحب التلقائي مع فواتير أخرى.

segments.src: If an account lacks the funds, the shopper may face bank overdraft charges on top of any fee from the lender.
segments.tr: إذا كان الحساب يفتقر إلى الأموال، فقد يواجه المتسوق رسوم السحب على المكشوف البنكية علاوة على أي رسوم من المقرض.

segments.src: **Returns and disputes.** If you return an item, the refund process can take time, and payments may continue in the meantime.
segments.tr: **الإرجاع والنزاعات.** إذا قمت بإرجاع عنصر، فقد تستغرق عملية الاسترداد وقتًا، وقد تستمر المدفوعات في هذه الأثناء.

segments.src: Dispute protections can also differ from those on credit cards.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تختلف حماية النزاعات أيضًا عن تلك الموجودة على بطاقات الائتمان.

segments.src: **Credit reporting gaps.** Many BNPL loans have not been consistently reported to the major credit bureaus.
segments.tr: **ثغرات التقارير الائتمانية.** لم يتم الإبلاغ عن العديد من قروض BNPL بشكل متسق إلى وكالات الائتمان الرئيسية.

segments.src: That can hide debt from other lenders.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يخفي ذلك الديون عن المقرضين الآخرين.

segments.src: It also means on-time payments may not always help build credit, while missed payments or collections can still cause damage.
segments.tr: كما يعني أن المدفوعات في موعدها قد لا تساعد دائما في بناء الائتمان، في حين أن المدفوعات الفائتة أو المجموعات لا تزال تسبب ضررا.

segments.src: **Spending creep.** Research on consumer behavior suggests that breaking a price into smaller pieces can make it feel less painful, which may lead to larger or more frequent purchases.
segments.tr: **تسلل الإنفاق.** يشير البحث في سلوك المستهلك إلى أن تقسيم السعر إلى قطع أصغر يمكن أن يجعله يبدو أقل إيلامًا، مما قد يؤدي إلى عمليات شراء أكبر أو أكثر تكرارًا.

segments.src: ## Rising Late Payments and Why They Matter
segments.tr: ## ارتفاع المدفوعات المتأخرة ولماذا هي مهمة

segments.src: Surveys of BNPL users have repeatedly found that a meaningful minority report paying late at least once.
segments.tr: وجدت استطلاعات مستخدمي BNPL مرارًا وتكرارًا أن أقلية ذات مغزى تبلغ عن الدفع متأخرة مرة واحدة على الأقل.

segments.src: Responses vary by study, age group, and income level, so exact figures differ.
segments.tr: تختلف الاستجابات حسب الدراسة، والفئة العمرية، ومستوى الدخل، لذا تختلف الأرقام الدقيقة.

segments.src: The pattern is consistent, though.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فإن النمط ثابتا.

segments.src: Late payments are more common among younger adults and among households already stretched by higher prices.
segments.tr: المدفوعات المتأخرة أكثر شيوعًا بين البالغين الأصغر سنًا وبين الأسر التي تعاني بالفعل من ارتفاع الأسعار.

segments.src: For household budgets, the concern is cumulative.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لميزانيات الاسر، القلق تراكمي.

segments.src: Holiday spending tends to arrive when other costs, such as heating, travel, and year-end bills, are also high.
segments.tr: تميل إنفاق العطلات إلى الوصول عندما تكون التكاليف الأخرى، مثل التدفئة والسفر وفواتير نهاية العام، مرتفعة أيضًا.

segments.src: Installments taken on in November and December come due in January and February, just as the festive spending has passed.
segments.tr: الأقساط التي تم تحملها في نوفمبر وديسمبر تستحق في يناير وفبراير، تمامًا كما مرت إنفاق الاحتفالات.

segments.src: A household that has also carried credit card balances may find that several small obligations add up to a significant monthly drain.
segments.tr: قد تجد الأسرة التي تحملت أرصدة بطاقات الائتمان أن العديد من الالتزامات الصغيرة تتراكم لتصبح استنزافًا شهريًا كبيرًا.

segments.src: Analysts also note that BNPL often reflects financial pressure, not just convenience.
segments.tr: ويشير المحللون أيضًا إلى أن BNPL غالباً ما يعكس ضغطاً مالياً وليس مجرد راحة.

segments.src: When shoppers use installments for everyday essentials such as groceries, that can signal tight budgets.
segments.tr: عندما يستخدم المتسوقون الأقساط للضروريات اليومية مثل البقالة، يمكن أن يشير ذلك إلى ميزانيات ضيقة.

segments.src: Economists watch this closely as one indicator of consumer stress.
segments.tr: يراقب الاقتصاديون هذا عن كثب باعتباره مؤشراً على إجهاد المستهلك.

segments.src: ## Growing Regulatory Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## التدقيق التنظيمي المتزايد

segments.src: Policymakers have taken a closer look at the industry as it has grown.
segments.tr: ألقى صانعو السياسات نظرة فاحصة على الصناعة مع نموها.

segments.src: Areas of focus include:
segments.tr: تشمل مجالات التركيز ما يلي:

segments.src: - **Disclosure.** Whether consumers clearly understand the terms, fees, and consequences of missed payments before they agree.
segments.tr: - **الإفصاح.** ما إذا كان المستهلكون يفهمون بوضوح الشروط والرسوم وعواقب المدفوعات الفائتة قبل أن يوافقوا.

segments.src: - **Credit reporting.** How BNPL loans should be reported, and whether they should be treated more like other forms of credit.
segments.tr: - **الإبلاغ الائتماني.** كيف ينبغي الإبلاغ عن قروض BNPL، وما إذا كان ينبغي معاملتها بشكل أكثر مثل الأشكال الأخرى من الائتمان.

segments.src: - **Consumer protections.** Dispute rights, refund handling, and treatment of borrowers who fall behind.
segments.tr: - **حماية المستهلك.** حقوق النزاع، ومعالجة الاسترداد، ومعاملة المقترضين الذين يتخلفون عن الركب.

segments.src: - **Data practices.** How lenders use shopper data and how they decide who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **ممارسات البيانات.** كيف يستخدم المقرضون بيانات المتسوق وكيف يقررون من المؤهل.

segments.src: Rules and guidance are evolving, and they differ by state and country.
segments.tr: القواعد والتوجيهات تتطور، وهي تختلف حسب الولاية والبلد.

segments.src: Consumers should check the current terms of any plan they use rather than assume the protections match those of a credit card.
segments.tr: يجب على المستهلكين التحقق من الشروط الحالية لأي خطة يستخدمونها بدلاً من افتراض أن الحماية تتطابق مع تلك الخاصة ببطاقة الائتمان.

segments.src: ## Smart Questions to Ask Before You Click
segments.tr: ## أسئلة ذكية يجب طرحها قبل النقر

segments.src: Before choosing a BNPL option this season, consider the following:
segments.tr: قبل اختيار خيار BNPL هذا الموسم، ضع في اعتبارك ما يلي:

segments.src: - **Can I pay for this in full without the plan?** If the only reason to split the payment is that you could not otherwise afford it, pause.
segments.tr: - **هل يمكنني دفع ثمن هذا بالكامل بدون الخطة؟** إذا كان السبب الوحيد لتقسيم الدفع هو أنه لا يمكنك تحمله بطريقة أخرى، فتوقف.

segments.src: - **What happens if I miss a payment?** Look for late fees, interest, and any effect on your account or credit.
segments.tr: - **ماذا يحدث إذا فاتني الدفع؟** ابحث عن رسوم التأخير والفوائد وأي تأثير على حسابك أو ائتمانك.

segments.src: - **Is my payment date aligned with my paycheck?** Autopay works best when the money is already there.
segments.tr: - **هل تاريخ الدفع الخاص بي متوافق مع راتبي؟** يعمل الدفع التلقائي بشكل أفضل عندما تكون الأموال موجودة بالفعل.

segments.src: - **How many plans do I have open?** Keep a simple list of every active installment and its due date.
segments.tr: - **كم عدد الخطط التي قمت بفتحها؟** احتفظ بقائمة بسيطة لكل قسط نشط وتاريخ استحقاقه.

segments.src: - **What is the return policy?** Know how refunds interact with remaining payments.
segments.tr: - **ما هي سياسة الإرجاع؟** تعرف على كيفية تفاعل المبالغ المستردة مع المدفوعات المتبقية.

segments.src: - **Is this a want or a need?** Installments are easiest to justify for planned purchases, not impulse buys.
segments.tr: - **هل هذا رغبة أم حاجة؟** الأقساط هي الأسهل لتبريرها لعمليات الشراء المخطط لها، وليس الشراء الاندفاعي.

segments.src: ## Practical Tips for Staying in Control
segments.tr: ## نصائح عملية للبقاء تحت السيطرة

segments.src: - **Set a holiday budget first,** and count installment payments as part of it.
segments.tr: - **حدد ميزانية العطلات أولاً،** واحتسب مدفوعات الأقساط كجزء منها.

segments.src: - **Use one provider when possible** so that your obligations are easier to track.
segments.tr: - **استخدم مزودًا واحدًا إن أمكن** حتى يسهل تتبع التزاماتك.

segments.src: - **Set calendar reminders** for each due date, even if autopay is on.
segments.tr: - **قم بتعيين تذكيرات التقويم** لكل تاريخ استحقاق، حتى لو كان الدفع التلقائي قيد التشغيل.

segments.src: - **Keep a cushion** in the linked account to avoid overdrafts.
segments.tr: - **احتفظ بوسادة** في الحساب المرتبط لتجنب السحب على المكشوف.

segments.src: - **Read the terms** on the final checkout screen, not just the headline offer.
segments.tr: - **اقرأ الشروط** على شاشة الخروج النهائية، وليس فقط عرض العنوان الرئيسي.

segments.src: - **Compare alternatives,** including a low-interest card you pay off right away, layaway programs, or simply waiting for a sale.
segments.tr: - **قارن البدائل،** بما في ذلك بطاقة منخفضة الفائدة تقوم بسدادها على الفور، أو برامج الشراء المؤجل، أو ببساطة انتظار التخفيضات.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Buy now, pay later can be a handy tool when it is used deliberately.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يكون الشراء الآن والدفع لاحقًا أداة مفيدة عندما يتم استخدامه عن قصد.

segments.src: It can also make spending feel lighter than it is, and small payments can pile up faster than expected.
segments.tr: يمكنه أيضًا جعل الإنفاق يبدو أخف من حقيقته، ويمكن أن تتراكم المدفوعات الصغيرة بشكل أسرع من المتوقع.

segments.src: As adoption grows and late payments draw attention, the sensible approach for shoppers is the same as with any credit: know what you owe, know when it is due, and make sure it fits the budget well beyond the holiday season.

fr.title: Achetez maintenant, payez plus tard pour les fêtes : commodité ou piège à dettes ?

segments.src: Holiday shopping has a new checkout option.
segments.tr: Les achats de fin d'année disposent d'une nouvelle option de paiement.

segments.src: Instead of paying the full price of a gift up front, millions of shoppers now split purchases into a handful of smaller payments.
segments.tr: Au lieu de payer le prix total d'un cadeau immédiatement, des millions d'acheteurs divisent désormais leurs achats en quelques petits paiements.

segments.src: These "buy now, pay later" (BNPL) plans are popular, quick to set up, and often advertised as interest-free.
segments.tr: Ces plans « achetez maintenant, payez plus tard » (BNPL) sont populaires, rapides à mettre en place et souvent présentés comme sans intérêts.

segments.src: They are also drawing closer attention from regulators, consumer advocates, and financial researchers.
segments.tr: Ils attirent également de plus en plus l'attention des régulateurs, des associations de consommateurs et des chercheurs en finance.

segments.src: This explainer covers how the plans work, what they can cost, and what the trend could mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: Cet article explicatif couvre le fonctionnement de ces plans, leur coût potentiel et ce que cette tendance pourrait signifier pour les budgets des ménages.

segments.src: ## What Is Buy Now, Pay Later?
segments.tr: ## Qu'est-ce que le « achetez maintenant, payez plus tard » ?

segments.src: BNPL is a form of short-term financing offered at online checkout or in stores.
segments.tr: Le BNPL est une forme de financement à court terme proposée lors du paiement en ligne ou en magasin.

segments.src: A shopper picks the plan, completes a quick eligibility check, and receives the item right away.
segments.tr: Un acheteur choisit le plan, effectue une vérification rapide d'éligibilité et reçoit l'article immédiatement.

segments.src: The cost is then spread over several installments.
segments.tr: Le coût est ensuite réparti sur plusieurs mensualités.

segments.src: The most common structure is the "pay in four" plan:
segments.tr: La structure la plus courante est le plan « paiement en quatre fois » :

segments.src: - **25% is paid at checkout.**
segments.tr: - **25 % sont payés au moment du paiement.**

segments.src: - **The remaining three payments are due every two weeks**, usually charged automatically to a debit card, credit card, or bank account.
segments.tr: - **Les trois paiements restants sont dus toutes les deux semaines**, généralement débités automatiquement d'une carte de débit, d'une carte de crédit ou d'un compte bancaire.

segments.src: - **No interest is charged** if every payment is made on time.
segments.tr: - **Aucun intérêt n'est facturé** si chaque paiement est effectué à temps.

segments.src: Longer plans also exist, typically for bigger purchases.
segments.tr: Il existe également des plans plus longs, généralement pour des achats plus importants.

segments.src: They run from several months to a few years and often carry interest.
segments.tr: Ils s'étendent de quelques mois à quelques années et comportent souvent des intérêts.

segments.src: Rates vary widely by lender and by the shopper's credit profile.
segments.tr: Les taux varient considérablement selon le prêteur et le profil de crédit de l'acheteur.

segments.src: ## Why the Plans Are So Popular
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ces plans sont-ils si populaires

segments.src: Several things make BNPL appealing, especially during the holidays:
segments.tr: Plusieurs éléments rendent le BNPL attrayant, surtout pendant les fêtes :

segments.src: 1. **Speed.** Approval often takes seconds and may not require a traditional credit application.
segments.tr: 1. **Rapidité.** L'approbation prend souvent quelques secondes et peut ne pas nécessiter de demande de crédit traditionnelle.

segments.src: 2. **Predictability.** Fixed payment amounts are easier to plan around than a revolving credit card balance.
segments.tr: 2. **Prévisibilité.** Des montants de paiement fixes sont plus faciles à prévoir qu'un solde de carte de crédit renouvelable.

segments.src: 3. **Accessibility.** People with limited or no credit history may qualify when they would not for a card.
segments.tr: 3. **Accessibilité.** Les personnes ayant un historique de crédit limité ou inexistant peuvent être éligibles alors qu'elles ne le seraient pas pour une carte.

segments.src: 4. **Perceived cost.** A $200 gift feels more manageable as four payments of $50.
segments.tr: 4. **Coût perçu.** Un cadeau de 200 $ semble plus gérable sous forme de quatre paiements de 50 $.

segments.src: Retail surveys in recent years have found that a growing share of consumers use BNPL during peak shopping periods.
segments.tr: Les enquêtes sur la vente au détail menées ces dernières années ont révélé qu'une part croissante de consommateurs utilise le BNPL pendant les périodes de forte affluence.

segments.src: Online retailers report that offering installment options can raise conversion rates and the average size of an order.
segments.tr: Les détaillants en ligne signalent que proposer des options de paiement en plusieurs fois peut augmenter les taux de conversion et la taille moyenne d'une commande.

segments.src: ## How the Companies Make Money
segments.tr: ## Comment les entreprises gagnent-elles de l'argent

segments.src: "Interest-free" does not mean the lender earns nothing.
segments.tr: « Sans intérêts » ne signifie pas que le prêteur ne gagne rien.

segments.src: BNPL providers typically make money in several ways:
segments.tr: Les fournisseurs de BNPL gagnent généralement de l'argent de plusieurs manières :

segments.src: - **Merchant fees.** Retailers usually pay the lender a percentage of each sale, often higher than standard card processing fees.
segments.tr: - **Frais de commerçant.** Les détaillants paient généralement au prêteur un pourcentage de chaque vente, souvent plus élevé que les frais de traitement de carte standard.

segments.src: - **Interest on longer loans.** Plans that stretch beyond a few installments may charge interest.
segments.tr: - **Intérêts sur les prêts plus longs.** Les plans qui s'étendent au-delà de quelques mensualités peuvent facturer des intérêts.

segments.src: - **Late fees.** Some providers charge a fee when a payment is missed. Others cap fees or have moved away from them.
segments.tr: - **Frais de retard.** Certains fournisseurs facturent des frais en cas de paiement manqué. D'autres plafonnent les frais ou ont cessé de les appliquer.

segments.src: - **Partnerships and other services.** Some companies also earn revenue through card programs, interchange income, and advertising.
segments.tr: - **Partenariats et autres services.** Certaines entreprises tirent également des revenus de programmes de cartes, de commissions d'interchange et de publicité.

segments.src: Because the model depends in part on sales volume, critics argue that it can encourage people to spend more than they otherwise would.
segments.tr: Comme le modèle dépend en partie du volume des ventes, les critiques soutiennent qu'il peut encourager les gens à dépenser plus qu'ils ne le feraient autrement.

segments.src: Supporters respond that it gives consumers a transparent, fixed-cost alternative to credit cards.
segments.tr: Les partisans répondent qu'il offre aux consommateurs une alternative transparente et à coût fixe aux cartes de crédit.

segments.src: ## What Can Go Wrong
segments.tr: ## Ce qui peut mal tourner

segments.src: BNPL is not automatically harmful.
segments.tr: Le BNPL n'est pas automatiquement nuisible.

segments.src: Used carefully for a planned purchase, it can be a useful cash-flow tool.
segments.tr: Utilisé avec précaution pour un achat planifié, il peut être un outil de gestion de trésorerie utile.

segments.src: The risks tend to come from how people use it.
segments.tr: Les risques ont tendance à provenir de la manière dont les gens l'utilisent.

segments.src: **Stacking.** Because each plan is small, shoppers can open several at once across different retailers and apps.
segments.tr: **Cumul.** Comme chaque plan est de faible montant, les acheteurs peuvent en ouvrir plusieurs à la fois chez différents détaillants et sur différentes applications.

segments.src: Total obligations can grow without the user noticing, and each lender may see only its own loan.
segments.tr: Le total des obligations peut augmenter sans que l'utilisateur ne s'en aperçoive, et chaque prêteur ne peut voir que son propre prêt.

segments.src: **Overdrafts and failed payments.** Automatic withdrawals can collide with other bills.
segments.tr: **Découverts et paiements échoués.** Les prélèvements automatiques peuvent entrer en conflit avec d'autres factures.

segments.src: If an account lacks the funds, the shopper may face bank overdraft charges on top of any fee from the lender.
segments.tr: Si le compte manque de fonds, l'acheteur peut faire face à des frais de découvert bancaire en plus des éventuels frais du prêteur.

segments.src: **Returns and disputes.** If you return an item, the refund process can take time, and payments may continue in the meantime.
segments.tr: **Retours et litiges.** Si vous retournez un article, le processus de remboursement peut prendre du temps et les paiements peuvent continuer entre-temps.

segments.src: Dispute protections can also differ from those on credit cards.
segments.tr: Les protections en cas de litige peuvent également différer de celles des cartes de crédit.

segments.src: **Credit reporting gaps.** Many BNPL loans have not been consistently reported to the major credit bureaus.
segments.tr: **Lacunes dans les rapports de crédit.** De nombreux prêts BNPL n'ont pas été systématiquement signalés aux principaux bureaux de crédit.

segments.src: That can hide debt from other lenders.
segments.tr: Cela peut cacher des dettes aux autres prêteurs.

segments.src: It also means on-time payments may not always help build credit, while missed payments or collections can still cause damage.
segments.tr: Cela signifie également que les paiements effectués à temps peuvent ne pas toujours aider à renforcer le crédit, tandis que les paiements manqués ou les recouvrements peuvent toujours causer des dommages.

segments.src: **Spending creep.** Research on consumer behavior suggests that breaking a price into smaller pieces can make it feel less painful, which may lead to larger or more frequent purchases.
segments.tr: **Dérive des dépenses.** Les recherches sur le comportement des consommateurs suggèrent que diviser un prix en plus petits morceaux peut rendre la dépense moins douloureuse, ce qui peut conduire à des achats plus importants ou plus fréquents.

segments.src: ## Rising Late Payments and Why They Matter
segments.tr: ## Augmentation des paiements en retard et pourquoi c'est important

segments.src: Surveys of BNPL users have repeatedly found that a meaningful minority report paying late at least once.
segments.tr: Les enquêtes auprès des utilisateurs de BNPL ont révélé à plusieurs reprises qu'une minorité significative déclare avoir payé en retard au moins une fois.

segments.src: Responses vary by study, age group, and income level, so exact figures differ.
segments.tr: Les réponses varient selon l'étude, le groupe d'âge et le niveau de revenu, de sorte que les chiffres exacts diffèrent.

segments.src: The pattern is consistent, though.
segments.tr: La tendance est cependant cohérente.

segments.src: Late payments are more common among younger adults and among households already stretched by higher prices.
segments.tr: Les retards de paiement sont plus fréquents chez les jeunes adultes et chez les ménages déjà mis à mal par la hausse des prix.

segments.src: For household budgets, the concern is cumulative.
segments.tr: Pour les budgets des ménages, le problème est cumulatif.

segments.src: Holiday spending tends to arrive when other costs, such as heating, travel, and year-end bills, are also high.
segments.tr: Les dépenses des fêtes ont tendance à arriver au moment où d'autres coûts, tels que le chauffage, les voyages et les factures de fin d'année, sont également élevés.

segments.src: Installments taken on in November and December come due in January and February, just as the festive spending has passed.
segments.tr: Les mensualités contractées en novembre et décembre arrivent à échéance en janvier et février, juste après la fin des dépenses festives.

segments.src: A household that has also carried credit card balances may find that several small obligations add up to a significant monthly drain.
segments.tr: Un ménage qui a également conservé des soldes de cartes de crédit peut constater que plusieurs petites obligations s'additionnent pour constituer une ponction mensuelle importante.

segments.src: Analysts also note that BNPL often reflects financial pressure, not just convenience.
segments.tr: Les analystes notent également que le BNPL reflète souvent une pression financière, et pas seulement une commodité.

segments.src: When shoppers use installments for everyday essentials such as groceries, that can signal tight budgets.
segments.tr: Lorsque les acheteurs utilisent le paiement en plusieurs fois pour des produits essentiels du quotidien comme l'épicerie, cela peut signaler des budgets serrés.

segments.src: Economists watch this closely as one indicator of consumer stress.
segments.tr: Les économistes surveillent cela de près comme un indicateur du stress des consommateurs.

segments.src: ## Growing Regulatory Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## Surveillance réglementaire croissante

segments.src: Policymakers have taken a closer look at the industry as it has grown.
segments.tr: Les décideurs politiques ont examiné le secteur de plus près à mesure qu'il se développait.

segments.src: Areas of focus include:
segments.tr: Les domaines d'intérêt incluent :

segments.src: - **Disclosure.** Whether consumers clearly understand the terms, fees, and consequences of missed payments before they agree.
segments.tr: - **Divulgation.** Si les consommateurs comprennent clairement les conditions, les frais et les conséquences des paiements manqués avant d'accepter.

segments.src: - **Credit reporting.** How BNPL loans should be reported, and whether they should be treated more like other forms of credit.
segments.tr: - **Rapports de crédit.** Comment les prêts BNPL doivent être signalés et s'ils doivent être traités davantage comme d'autres formes de crédit.

segments.src: - **Consumer protections.** Dispute rights, refund handling, and treatment of borrowers who fall behind.
segments.tr: - **Protections des consommateurs.** Droits en cas de litige, gestion des remboursements et traitement des emprunteurs en retard de paiement.

segments.src: - **Data practices.** How lenders use shopper data and how they decide who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Pratiques en matière de données.** Comment les prêteurs utilisent les données des acheteurs et comment ils décident qui est éligible.

segments.src: Rules and guidance are evolving, and they differ by state and country.
segments.tr: Les règles et les conseils évoluent et diffèrent selon l'État et le pays.

segments.src: Consumers should check the current terms of any plan they use rather than assume the protections match those of a credit card.
segments.tr: Les consommateurs devraient vérifier les conditions actuelles de tout plan qu'ils utilisent plutôt que de supposer que les protections correspondent à celles d'une carte de crédit.

segments.src: ## Smart Questions to Ask Before You Click
segments.tr: ## Questions intelligentes à se poser avant de cliquer

segments.src: Before choosing a BNPL option this season, consider the following:
segments.tr: Avant de choisir une option BNPL cette saison, considérez ce qui suit :

segments.src: - **Can I pay for this in full without the plan?** If the only reason to split the payment is that you could not otherwise afford it, pause.
segments.tr: - **Puis-je payer la totalité sans ce plan ?** Si la seule raison de diviser le paiement est que vous ne pourriez pas vous le permettre autrement, réfléchissez.

segments.src: - **What happens if I miss a payment?** Look for late fees, interest, and any effect on your account or credit.
segments.tr: - **Que se passe-t-il si je manque un paiement ?** Recherchez les frais de retard, les intérêts et tout effet sur votre compte ou votre crédit.

segments.src: - **Is my payment date aligned with my paycheck?** Autopay works best when the money is already there.
segments.tr: - **Ma date de paiement est-elle alignée avec mon salaire ?** Le paiement automatique fonctionne mieux lorsque l'argent est déjà disponible.

segments.src: - **How many plans do I have open?** Keep a simple list of every active installment and its due date.
segments.tr: - **Combien de plans ai-je en cours ?** Tenez une liste simple de chaque mensualité active et de sa date d'échéance.

segments.src: - **What is the return policy?** Know how refunds interact with remaining payments.
segments.tr: - **Quelle est la politique de retour ?** Sachez comment les remboursements interagissent avec les paiements restants.

segments.src: - **Is this a want or a need?** Installments are easiest to justify for planned purchases, not impulse buys.
segments.tr: - **Est-ce une envie ou un besoin ?** Les paiements en plusieurs fois sont plus faciles à justifier pour des achats planifiés, pas pour des achats impulsifs.

segments.src: ## Practical Tips for Staying in Control
segments.tr: ## Conseils pratiques pour garder le contrôle

segments.src: - **Set a holiday budget first,** and count installment payments as part of it.
segments.tr: - **Fixez d'abord un budget pour les fêtes,** et comptez les paiements en plusieurs fois comme faisant partie de celui-ci.

segments.src: - **Use one provider when possible** so that your obligations are easier to track.
segments.tr: - **Utilisez un seul fournisseur si possible** afin que vos obligations soient plus faciles à suivre.

segments.src: - **Set calendar reminders** for each due date, even if autopay is on.
segments.tr: - **Définissez des rappels dans votre calendrier** pour chaque date d'échéance, même si le paiement automatique est activé.

segments.src: - **Keep a cushion** in the linked account to avoid overdrafts.
segments.tr: - **Gardez une réserve** sur le compte lié pour éviter les découverts.

segments.src: - **Read the terms** on the final checkout screen, not just the headline offer.
segments.tr: - **Lisez les conditions** sur l'écran de paiement final, pas seulement l'offre principale.

segments.src: - **Compare alternatives,** including a low-interest card you pay off right away, layaway programs, or simply waiting for a sale.
segments.tr: - **Comparez les alternatives,** y compris une carte à faible taux d'intérêt que vous remboursez immédiatement, les programmes de mise de côté ou simplement attendre les soldes.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: Buy now, pay later can be a handy tool when it is used deliberately.
segments.tr: Le « achetez maintenant, payez plus tard » peut être un outil pratique lorsqu'il est utilisé de manière réfléchie.

segments.src: It can also make spending feel lighter than it is, and small payments can pile up faster than expected.
segments.tr: Il peut également donner l'impression que les dépenses sont plus légères qu'elles ne le sont, et les petits paiements peuvent s'accumuler plus rapidement que prévu.

segments.src: As adoption grows and late payments draw attention, the sensible approach for shoppers is the same as with any credit: know what you owe, know when it is due, and make sure it fits the budget well beyond the holiday season.
segments.tr: À mesure que l'adoption augmente et que les retards de paiement attirent l'attention, l'approche sensée pour les acheteurs est la même que pour tout crédit : sachez ce que vous devez, sachez quand c'est dû et assurez-vous que cela correspond au budget bien au-delà de la saison des fêtes.

segments.tr: *Cet article est fourni à titre d'information générale uniquement et ne constitue pas un conseil financier.

segments.src: Terms, fees, and regulations vary by provider and location.
segments.tr: Les conditions, les frais et les réglementations varient selon le fournisseur et le lieu.

segments.src: Review the details of any financial product before using it, and consider consulting a qualified professional for personal guidance.*
segments.tr: Examinez les détails de tout produit financier avant de l'utiliser et envisagez de consulter un professionnel qualifié pour obtenir des conseils personnalisés.*

segments.tr: - **Taxas dos comerciantes.** Os varejistas geralmente pagam ao credor uma porcentagem de cada venda, frequentemente mais alta do que as taxas padrão de processamento de cartão.

segments.src: - **Interest on longer loans.** Plans that stretch beyond a few installments may charge interest.
segments.tr: - **Juros em empréstimos mais longos.** Planos que se estendem além de algumas parcelas podem cobrar juros.

segments.src: - **Late fees.** Some providers charge a fee when a payment is missed. Others cap fees or have moved away from them.
segments.tr: - **Multas por atraso.** Alguns provedores cobram uma taxa quando um pagamento é perdido. Outros impõem limites a essas taxas ou deixaram de cobrá-las.

segments.src: - **Partnerships and other services.** Some companies also earn revenue through card programs, interchange income, and advertising.
segments.tr: - **Parcerias e outros serviços.** Algumas empresas também geram receita por meio de programas de cartão, tarifas de intercâmbio e publicidade.

segments.src: Because the model depends in part on sales volume, critics argue that it can encourage people to spend more than they otherwise would.
segments.tr: Como o modelo depende em parte do volume de vendas, os críticos argumentam que ele pode incentivar as pessoas a gastarem mais do que gastariam de outra forma.

segments.src: Supporters respond that it gives consumers a transparent, fixed-cost alternative to credit cards.
segments.tr: Os defensores respondem que ele oferece aos consumidores uma alternativa transparente e de custo fixo ao cartão de crédito.

segments.src: ## What Can Go Wrong
segments.tr: ## O Que Pode Dar Errado

segments.src: BNPL is not automatically harmful.
segments.tr: O BNPL não é prejudicial de forma automática.

segments.src: Used carefully for a planned purchase, it can be a useful cash-flow tool.
segments.tr: Usado com cuidado para uma compra planejada, pode ser uma ferramenta útil de fluxo de caixa.

segments.src: The risks tend to come from how people use it.
segments.tr: Os riscos costumam surgir da forma como as pessoas o utilizam.

segments.src: **Stacking.** Because each plan is small, shoppers can open several at once across different retailers and apps.
segments.tr: **Acúmulo de parcelas.** Como cada plano é pequeno, os compradores podem abrir vários ao mesmo tempo em diferentes varejistas e aplicativos.

segments.src: Total obligations can grow without the user noticing, and each lender may see only its own loan.
segments.tr: O total das obrigações pode crescer sem que o usuário perceba, e cada credor pode enxergar apenas o seu próprio empréstimo.

segments.src: **Overdrafts and failed payments.** Automatic withdrawals can collide with other bills.
segments.tr: **Cheque especial e falhas no pagamento.** Retiradas automáticas podem coincidir com outras contas.

segments.src: If an account lacks the funds, the shopper may face bank overdraft charges on top of any fee from the lender.
segments.tr: Se uma conta não tiver fundos, o comprador pode enfrentar tarifas de cheque especial do banco, além de qualquer multa do credor.

segments.src: **Returns and disputes.** If you return an item, the refund process can take time, and payments may continue in the meantime.
segments.tr: **Devoluções e disputas.** Se você devolver um item, o processo de reembolso pode demorar, e os pagamentos podem continuar nesse meio-tempo.

segments.src: Dispute protections can also differ from those on credit cards.
segments.tr: As proteções contra disputas também podem ser diferentes das oferecidas pelos cartões de crédito.

segments.src: **Credit reporting gaps.** Many BNPL loans have not been consistently reported to the major credit bureaus.
segments.tr: **Lacunas nos relatórios de crédito.** Muitos empréstimos BNPL não têm sido relatados de forma consistente aos principais órgãos de proteção ao crédito.

segments.src: That can hide debt from other lenders.
segments.tr: Isso pode ocultar dívidas de outros credores.

segments.src: It also means on-time payments may not always help build credit, while missed payments or collections can still cause damage.
segments.tr: Isso também significa que pagamentos em dia nem sempre ajudam a construir um histórico de crédito, enquanto pagamentos em atraso ou cobranças ainda podem causar danos.

segments.src: **Spending creep.** Research on consumer behavior suggests that breaking a price into smaller pieces can make it feel less painful, which may lead to larger or more frequent purchases.
segments.tr: **Aumento gradual de gastos.** Pesquisas sobre o comportamento do consumidor sugerem que dividir o preço em partes menores pode fazer com que ele pareça menos doloroso, o que pode levar a compras maiores ou mais frequentes.

segments.src: ## Rising Late Payments and Why They Matter
segments.tr: ## O Aumento dos Pagamentos em Atraso e Por Que Isso Importa

segments.src: Surveys of BNPL users have repeatedly found that a meaningful minority report paying late at least once.
segments.tr: Pesquisas com usuários de BNPL revelaram repetidamente que uma minoria expressiva relata ter pago em atraso pelo menos uma vez.

segments.src: Responses vary by study, age group, and income level, so exact figures differ.
segments.tr: As respostas variam de acordo com o estudo, a faixa etária e o nível de renda, portanto os números exatos diferem.

segments.src: The pattern is consistent, though.
segments.tr: No entanto, o padrão é consistente.

segments.src: Late payments are more common among younger adults and among households already stretched by higher prices.
segments.tr: Pagamentos em atraso são mais comuns entre adultos mais jovens e entre famílias que já estão pressionadas por preços mais altos.

segments.src: For household budgets, the concern is cumulative.
segments.tr: Para o orçamento familiar, a preocupação é acumulativa.

segments.src: Holiday spending tends to arrive when other costs, such as heating, travel, and year-end bills, are also high.
segments.tr: Os gastos de fim de ano costumam chegar quando outros custos, como aquecimento, viagens e contas de encerramento de ano, também estão altos.

segments.src: Installments taken on in November and December come due in January and February, just as the festive spending has passed.
segments.tr: As parcelas assumidas em novembro e dezembro vencem em janeiro e fevereiro, justamente quando os gastos festivos já passaram.

segments.src: A household that has also carried credit card balances may find that several small obligations add up to a significant monthly drain.
segments.tr: Uma família que também acumulou saldos no cartão de crédito pode descobrir que várias pequenas obrigações se somam para formar uma drenagem mensal significativa.

segments.src: Analysts also note that BNPL often reflects financial pressure, not just convenience.
segments.tr: Analistas também observam que o BNPL frequentemente reflete pressão financeira, não apenas conveniência.

segments.src: When shoppers use installments for everyday essentials such as groceries, that can signal tight budgets.
segments.tr: Quando os compradores usam o parcelamento para itens essenciais do dia a dia, como compras de supermercado, isso pode sinalizar orçamentos apertados.

segments.src: Economists watch this closely as one indicator of consumer stress.
segments.tr: Os economistas acompanham isso de perto como um indicador do estresse do consumidor.

segments.src: ## Growing Regulatory Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## Crescente Escrutínio Regulatório

segments.src: Policymakers have taken a closer look at the industry as it has grown.
segments.tr: Os formuladores de políticas públicas têm analisado o setor mais de perto à medida que ele cresce.

segments.src: Areas of focus include:
segments.tr: As áreas de foco incluem:

segments.src: - **Disclosure.** Whether consumers clearly understand the terms, fees, and consequences of missed payments before they agree.
segments.tr: - **Transparência.** Se os consumidores compreendem claramente os termos, taxas e consequências de pagamentos não efetuados antes de concordarem.

segments.src: - **Credit reporting.** How BNPL loans should be reported, and whether they should be treated more like other forms of credit.
segments.tr: - **Relatórios de crédito.** Como os empréstimos BNPL devem ser informados e se devem ser tratados de forma mais semelhante a outras formas de crédito.

segments.src: - **Consumer protections.** Dispute rights, refund handling, and treatment of borrowers who fall behind.
segments.tr: - **Proteção ao consumidor.** Direitos de disputa, tratamento de reembolsos e tratamento dispensado a tomadores de empréstimos em atraso.

segments.src: - **Data practices.** How lenders use shopper data and how they decide who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Práticas de dados.** Como os credores usam os dados dos compradores e como decidem quem se qualifica.

segments.src: Rules and guidance are evolving, and they differ by state and country.
segments.tr: As regras e orientações estão evoluindo e diferem de acordo com o estado e o país.

segments.src: Consumers should check the current terms of any plan they use rather than assume the protections match those of a credit card.
segments.tr: Os consumidores devem verificar os termos atuais de qualquer plano que utilizem, em vez de presumir que as proteções correspondem às de um cartão de crédito.

segments.src: ## Smart Questions to Ask Before You Click
segments.tr: ## Perguntas Inteligentes a Fazer Antes de Clicar

segments.src: Before choosing a BNPL option this season, consider the following:
segments.tr: Antes de escolher uma opção de BNPL nesta temporada, considere o seguinte:

segments.src: - **Can I pay for this in full without the plan?** If the only reason to split the payment is that you could not otherwise afford it, pause.
segments.tr: - **Posso pagar por isso integralmente sem o plano?** Se o único motivo para dividir o pagamento for o fato de você não poder arcar com ele de outra forma, faça uma pausa.

segments.src: - **What happens if I miss a payment?** Look for late fees, interest, and any effect on your account or credit.
segments.tr: - **O que acontece se eu perder um pagamento?** Procure informações sobre multas por atraso, juros e qualquer efeito em sua conta ou crédito.

segments.src: - **Is my payment date aligned with my paycheck?** Autopay works best when the money is already there.
segments.tr: - **A minha data de pagamento está alinhada com o meu salário?** O pagamento automático funciona melhor quando o dinheiro já está lá.

segments.src: - **How many plans do I have open?** Keep a simple list of every active installment and its due date.
segments.tr: - **Quantos planos eu tenho abertos?** Mantenha uma lista simples de cada parcela ativa e sua data de vencimento.

segments.src: - **What is the return policy?** Know how refunds interact with remaining payments.
segments.tr: - **Qual é a política de devolução?** Saiba como os reembolsos interagem com as parcelas restantes.

segments.src: - **Is this a want or a need?** Installments are easiest to justify for planned purchases, not impulse buys.
segments.tr: - **Isto é um desejo ou uma necessidade?** O parcelamento é mais fácil de justificar para compras planejadas, não para compras por impulso.

segments.src: ## Practical Tips for Staying in Control
segments.tr: ## Dicas Práticas para Manter o Controle

segments.src: - **Set a holiday budget first,** and count installment payments as part of it.
segments.tr: - **Defina um orçamento para as festas primeiro,** e inclua os pagamentos parcelados como parte dele.

segments.src: - **Use one provider when possible** so that your obligations are easier to track.
segments.tr: - **Use apenas um provedor quando possível** para que suas obrigações sejam mais fáceis de acompanhar.

segments.src: - **Set calendar reminders** for each due date, even if autopay is on.
segments.tr: - **Crie lembretes no calendário** para cada data de vencimento, mesmo que o pagamento automático esteja ativado.

segments.src: - **Keep a cushion** in the linked account to avoid overdrafts.
segments.tr: - **Mantenha uma reserva** na conta vinculada para evitar taxas de cheque especial.

segments.src: - **Read the terms** on the final checkout screen, not just the headline offer.
segments.tr: - **Leia os termos** na tela final de checkout, não apenas a oferta principal.

segments.src: - **Compare alternatives,** including a low-interest card you pay off right away, layaway programs, or simply waiting for a sale.
segments.tr: - **Compare alternativas,** incluindo um cartão com juros baixos que você Quite imediatamente, programas de reserva de compras ou simplesmente esperar por uma promoção.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## O Resultado Final

segments.src: Buy now, pay later can be a handy tool when it is used deliberately.
segments.tr: O compre agora, pague depois pode ser uma ferramenta útil quando usado de forma deliberada.

segments.src: It can also make spending feel lighter than it is, and small payments can pile up faster than expected.
segments.tr: Ele também pode fazer com que os gastos pareçam mais leves do que realmente são, e pequenas parcelas podem se acumular mais rápido do que o esperado.

segments.src: As adoption grows and late payments draw attention, the sensible approach for shoppers is the same as with any credit: know what you owe, know when it is due, and make sure it fits the budget well beyond the holiday season.
segments.tr: À medida que a adoção cresce e os pagamentos em atraso atraem atenção, a abordagem sensata para os compradores é a mesma adotada com qualquer crédito: saiba o que você deve, saiba quando vence e garanta que isso se encaixe bem no orçamento para muito além da temporada de festas.

segments.tr: *Este artigo destina-se apenas a fins informativos gerais e não constitui aconselhamento financeiro.

segments.tr: Termos, taxas e regulamentos variam de acordo com o provedor e a localização.

segments.tr: Revise os detalhes de qualquer produto financeiro antes de usá-lo e considere consultar um profissional qualificado para obter orientação personalizada.*

in.title: Beli Sekarang, Bayar Nanti di Musim Liburan Ini: Kenyamanan atau Jebakan Utang?

segments.src: Holiday shopping has a new checkout option.
segments.tr: Belanja liburan kini memiliki opsi pembayaran baru.

segments.src: Instead of paying the full price of a gift up front, millions of shoppers now split purchases into a handful of smaller payments.
segments.tr: Alih-alih membayar harga penuh hadiah di muka, jutaan pembeli kini membagi pembelian menjadi beberapa pembayaran yang lebih kecil.

segments.src: These "buy now, pay later" (BNPL) plans are popular, quick to set up, and often advertised as interest-free.
segments.tr: Rencana "beli sekarang, bayar nanti" (BNPL) ini populer, cepat disiapkan, dan sering diiklankan sebagai bebas bunga.

segments.src: They are also drawing closer attention from regulators, consumer advocates, and financial researchers.
segments.tr: Rencana ini juga menarik perhatian lebih dekat dari regulator, advokat konsumen, dan peneliti keuangan.

segments.src: This explainer covers how the plans work, what they can cost, and what the trend could mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: Penjelasan ini mencakup cara kerja rencana tersebut, biaya yang mungkin timbul, dan apa arti tren ini bagi anggaran rumah tangga.

segments.src: ## What Is Buy Now, Pay Later?
segments.tr: ## Apa Itu Beli Sekarang, Bayar Nanti?

segments.src: BNPL is a form of short-term financing offered at online checkout or in stores.
segments.tr: BNPL adalah bentuk pembiayaan jangka pendek yang ditawarkan saat pembayaran daring atau di toko.

segments.src: A shopper picks the plan, completes a quick eligibility check, and receives the item right away.
segments.tr: Pembeli memilih rencana tersebut, menyelesaikan pemeriksaan kelayakan singkat, dan menerima barang secara langsung.

segments.src: The cost is then spread over several installments.
segments.tr: Biaya kemudian disebar selama beberapa kali cicilan.

segments.src: The most common structure is the "pay in four" plan:
segments.tr: Struktur yang paling umum adalah rencana "bayar dalam empat kali":

segments.src: - **25% is paid at checkout.**
segments.tr: - **25% dibayarkan saat pembayaran.**

segments.src: - **The remaining three payments are due every two weeks**, usually charged automatically to a debit card, credit card, or bank account.
segments.tr: - **Tiga pembayaran sisanya jatuh tempo setiap dua minggu**, biasanya dibebankan secara otomatis ke kartu debit, kartu kredit, atau rekening bank.

segments.src: - **No interest is charged** if every payment is made on time.
segments.tr: - **Tidak ada bunga yang dibebankan** jika setiap pembayaran dilakukan tepat waktu.

segments.src: Longer plans also exist, typically for bigger purchases.
segments.tr: Rencana yang lebih lama juga ada, biasanya untuk pembelian yang lebih besar.

segments.src: They run from several months to a few years and often carry interest.
segments.tr: Rencana ini berlangsung dari beberapa bulan hingga beberapa tahun dan sering kali dikenakan bunga.

segments.src: Rates vary widely by lender and by the shopper's credit profile.
segments.tr: Tarif sangat bervariasi tergantung pemberi pinjaman dan profil kredit pembeli.

segments.src: ## Why the Plans Are So Popular
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Rencana Ini Begitu Populer

segments.src: Several things make BNPL appealing, especially during the holidays:
segments.tr: Beberapa hal membuat BNPL menarik, terutama selama liburan:

segments.src: 1. **Speed.** Approval often takes seconds and may not require a traditional credit application.
segments.tr: 1. **Kecepatan.** Persetujuan sering kali memakan waktu beberapa detik dan mungkin tidak memerlukan aplikasi kredit tradisional.

segments.src: 2. **Predictability.** Fixed payment amounts are easier to plan around than a revolving credit card balance.
segments.tr: 2. **Prediktabilitas.** Jumlah pembayaran tetap lebih mudah direncanakan daripada saldo kartu kredit yang bergulir.

segments.src: 3. **Accessibility.** People with limited or no credit history may qualify when they would not for a card.
segments.tr: 3. **Aksesibilitas.** Orang dengan riwayat kredit terbatas atau tidak ada sama sekali mungkin memenuhi syarat padahal tidak untuk kartu kredit.

segments.src: 4. **Perceived cost.** A $200 gift feels more manageable as four payments of $50.
segments.tr: 4. **Biaya yang dirasakan.** Hadiah seharga $200 terasa lebih terjangkau sebagai empat pembayaran sebesar $50.

segments.src: Retail surveys in recent years have found that a growing share of consumers use BNPL during peak shopping periods.
segments.tr: Survei ritel dalam beberapa tahun terakhir menemukan bahwa semakin banyak konsumen menggunakan BNPL selama periode belanja puncak.

segments.src: Online retailers report that offering installment options can raise conversion rates and the average size of an order.
segments.tr: Pengecer daring melaporkan bahwa menawarkan opsi cicilan dapat meningkatkan tingkat konversi dan ukuran rata-rata pesanan.

segments.src: ## How the Companies Make Money
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Perusahaan Menghasilkan Uang

segments.src: "Interest-free" does not mean the lender earns nothing.
segments.tr: "Bebas bunga" bukan berarti pemberi pinjaman tidak mendapatkan apa-apa.

segments.src: BNPL providers typically make money in several ways:
segments.tr: Penyedia BNPL biasanya menghasilkan uang dengan beberapa cara:

segments.src: - **Merchant fees.** Retailers usually pay the lender a percentage of each sale, often higher than standard card processing fees.
segments.tr: - **Biaya pedagang.** Pengecer biasanya membayar pemberi pinjaman persentase dari setiap penjualan, sering kali lebih tinggi daripada biaya pemrosesan kartu standar.

segments.src: - **Interest on longer loans.** Plans that stretch beyond a few installments may charge interest.
segments.tr: - **Bunga atas pinjaman yang lebih lama.** Rencana yang berlangsung lebih dari beberapa kali cicilan mungkin mengenakan bunga.

segments.src: - **Late fees.** Some providers charge a fee when a payment is missed. Others cap fees or have moved away from them.
segments.tr: - **Biaya keterlambatan.** Beberapa penyedia mengenakan biaya ketika pembayaran terlewat. Yang lain membatasi biaya atau telah beralih dari biaya tersebut.

segments.src: - **Partnerships and other services.** Some companies also earn revenue through card programs, interchange income, and advertising.
segments.tr: - **Kemitraan dan layanan lainnya.** Beberapa perusahaan juga memperoleh pendapatan melalui program kartu, pendapatan pertukaran, dan iklan.

segments.src: Because the model depends in part on sales volume, critics argue that it can encourage people to spend more than they otherwise would.
segments.tr: Karena model ini sebagian bergantung pada volume penjualan, para kritikus berpendapat bahwa hal ini dapat mendorong orang untuk membelanjakan lebih banyak daripada yang seharusnya.

segments.src: Supporters respond that it gives consumers a transparent, fixed-cost alternative to credit cards.
segments.tr: Para pendukung menanggapi bahwa ini memberi konsumen alternatif biaya tetap yang transparan dibandingkan kartu kredit.

segments.src: ## What Can Go Wrong
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Bisa Salah

segments.tr: BNPL tidak secara otomatis berbahaya.

segments.tr: Jika digunakan dengan hati-hati untuk pembelian yang direncanakan, ini bisa menjadi alat arus kas yang berguna.

segments.tr: Risiko cenderung datang dari cara orang menggunakannya.

segments.tr: **Penumpukan.** Karena setiap rencana kecil, pembeli dapat membuka beberapa rencana sekaligus di berbagai pengecer dan aplikasi.

segments.src: Total obligations can grow without the user noticing, and each lender may see only its own loan.
segments.tr: Total kewajiban dapat tumbuh tanpa disadari oleh pengguna, dan setiap pemberi pinjaman mungkin hanya melihat pinjamannya sendiri.

segments.src: **Overdrafts and failed payments.** Automatic withdrawals can collide with other bills.
segments.tr: **Cerukan dan pembayaran gagal.** Penarikan otomatis dapat bertabrakan dengan tagihan lain.

segments.tr: Jika rekening tidak memiliki dana, pembeli mungkin menghadapi biaya cerukan bank di samping biaya apa pun dari pemberi pinjaman.

segments.src: **Returns and disputes.** If you return an item, the refund process can take time, and payments may continue in the meantime.
segments.tr: **Pengembalian dan sengketa.** Jika Anda mengembalikan barang, proses pengembalian dana bisa memakan waktu, dan pembayaran mungkin terus berlanjut sementara itu.

segments.tr: Perlindungan sengketa juga bisa berbeda dari yang ada pada kartu kredit.

segments.src: **Credit reporting gaps.** Many BNPL loans have not been consistently reported to the major credit bureaus.
segments.tr: **Kesenjangan pelaporan kredit.** Banyak pinjaman BNPL belum dilaporkan secara konsisten ke biro kredit utama.

segments.src: That can hide debt from other lenders.
segments.tr: Hal itu dapat menyembunyikan utang dari pemberi pinjaman lain.

segments.src: It also means on-time payments may not always help build credit, while missed payments or collections can still cause damage.
segments.tr: Ini juga berarti pembayaran tepat waktu mungkin tidak selalu membantu membangun kredit, sementara pembayaran yang terlewat atau penagihan masih dapat menyebabkan kerusakan.

segments.src: **Spending creep.** Research on consumer behavior suggests that breaking a price into smaller pieces can make it feel less painful, which may lead to larger or more frequent purchases.
segments.tr: **Peningkatan pengeluaran.** Penelitian tentang perilaku konsumen menunjukkan bahwa memecah harga menjadi bagian-bagian yang lebih kecil dapat membuatnya terasa tidak terlalu menyakitkan, yang dapat menyebabkan pembelian yang lebih besar atau lebih sering.

segments.tr: ## Meningkatnya Pembayaran Terlambat dan Mengapa Itu Penting

segments.tr: Rumah tangga yang juga memiliki saldo kartu kredit mungkin mendapati bahwa beberapa kewajiban kecil bertambah menjadi penguras bulanan yang signifikan.

segments.src: Analysts also note that BNPL often reflects financial pressure, not just convenience.
segments.tr: Analis juga mencatat bahwa BNPL sering mencerminkan tekanan keuangan, bukan sekadar kenyamanan.

segments.src: When shoppers use installments for everyday essentials such as groceries, that can signal tight budgets.
segments.tr: Ketika pembeli menggunakan cicilan untuk kebutuhan sehari-hari seperti bahan makanan, itu bisa menandakan anggaran yang ketat.

segments.src: Economists watch this closely as one indicator of consumer stress.
segments.tr: Para ekonom mengamati hal ini dengan cermat sebagai salah satu indikator tekanan konsumen.

segments.src: ## Growing Regulatory Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## Meningkatnya Pengawasan Regulasi

segments.src: Policymakers have taken a closer look at the industry as it has grown.
segments.tr: Para pembuat kebijakan telah melihat lebih dekat industri ini seiring pertumbuhannya.

segments.src: Areas of focus include:
segments.tr: Area fokus meliputi:

segments.src: - **Disclosure.** Whether consumers clearly understand the terms, fees, and consequences of missed payments before they agree.
segments.tr: - **Pengungkapan.** Apakah konsumen memahami dengan jelas ketentuan, biaya, dan konsekuensi dari pembayaran yang terlewat sebelum mereka setuju.

segments.src: - **Credit reporting.** How BNPL loans should be reported, and whether they should be treated more like other forms of credit.
segments.tr: - **Pelaporan kredit.** Bagaimana pinjaman BNPL harus dilaporkan, dan apakah mereka harus diperlakukan lebih seperti bentuk kredit lainnya.

segments.src: - **Consumer protections.** Dispute rights, refund handling, and treatment of borrowers who fall behind.
segments.tr: - **Perlindungan konsumen.** Hak sengketa, penanganan pengembalian dana, dan perlakuan terhadap peminjam yang tertinggal.

segments.src: - **Data practices.** How lenders use shopper data and how they decide who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Praktik data.** Bagaimana pemberi pinjaman menggunakan data pembeli dan bagaimana mereka memutuskan siapa yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: Rules and guidance are evolving, and they differ by state and country.
segments.tr: Aturan dan panduan terus berkembang, dan berbeda menurut negara bagian dan negara.

segments.src: Consumers should check the current terms of any plan they use rather than assume the protections match those of a credit card.
segments.tr: Konsumen harus memeriksa ketentuan saat ini dari rencana apa pun yang mereka gunakan daripada berasumsi bahwa perlindungannya sama dengan kartu kredit.

segments.src: ## Smart Questions to Ask Before You Click
segments.tr: ## Pertanyaan Cerdas untuk Ditanyakan Sebelum Anda Mengklik

segments.src: Before choosing a BNPL option this season, consider the following:
segments.tr: Sebelum memilih opsi BNPL musim ini, pertimbangkan hal berikut:

segments.src: - **Can I pay for this in full without the plan?** If the only reason to split the payment is that you could not otherwise afford it, pause.
segments.tr: - **Bisakah saya membayar ini secara penuh tanpa rencana tersebut?** Jika satu-satunya alasan untuk membagi pembayaran adalah karena Anda tidak mampu membelinya, berhentilah sejenak.

segments.src: - **What happens if I miss a payment?** Look for late fees, interest, and any effect on your account or credit.
segments.tr: - **Apa yang terjadi jika saya melewatkan pembayaran?** Cari biaya keterlambatan, bunga, dan efek apa pun pada akun atau kredit Anda.

segments.src: - **Is my payment date aligned with my paycheck?** Autopay works best when the money is already there.
segments.tr: - **Apakah tanggal pembayaran saya selaras dengan gaji saya?** Pembayaran otomatis bekerja paling baik saat uang sudah ada di sana.

segments.src: - **How many plans do I have open?** Keep a simple list of every active installment and its due date.
segments.tr: - **Berapa banyak rencana yang saya buka?** Simpan daftar sederhana dari setiap cicilan aktif dan tanggal jatuh temponya.

segments.src: - **What is the return policy?** Know how refunds interact with remaining payments.
segments.tr: - **Apa kebijakan pengembaliannya?** Ketahui bagaimana pengembalian dana berinteraksi dengan pembayaran yang tersisa.

segments.src: - **Is this a want or a need?** Installments are easiest to justify for planned purchases, not impulse buys.
segments.tr: - **Apakah ini keinginan atau kebutuhan?** Cicilan paling mudah dibenarkan untuk pembelian yang direncanakan, bukan pembelian impulsif.

segments.src: ## Practical Tips for Staying in Control
segments.tr: ## Tips Praktis untuk Tetap Terkendali

segments.src: - **Set a holiday budget first,** and count installment payments as part of it.
segments.tr: - **Tetapkan anggaran liburan terlebih dahulu,** dan hitung pembayaran cicilan sebagai bagian darinya.

segments.src: - **Use one provider when possible** so that your obligations are easier to track.
segments.tr: - **Gunakan satu penyedia jika memungkinkan** agar kewajiban Anda lebih mudah dilacak.

segments.src: - **Set calendar reminders** for each due date, even if autopay is on.
segments.tr: - **Atur pengingat kalender** untuk setiap tanggal jatuh tempo, meskipun pembayaran otomatis aktif.

segments.src: - **Keep a cushion** in the linked account to avoid overdrafts.
segments.tr: - **Simpan bantalan** di rekening yang terhubung untuk menghindari cerukan.

segments.src: - **Read the terms** on the final checkout screen, not just the headline offer.
segments.tr: - **Baca ketentuan** di layar pembayaran akhir, bukan hanya penawaran utama.

segments.src: - **Compare alternatives,** including a low-interest card you pay off right away, layaway programs, or simply waiting for a sale.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan alternatif,** termasuk kartu berbunga rendah yang Anda lunasi segera, program layaway, atau sekadar menunggu diskon.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: Buy now, pay later can be a handy tool when it is used deliberately.
segments.tr: Beli sekarang, bayar nanti bisa menjadi alat yang praktis jika digunakan dengan sengaja.

segments.src: It can also make spending feel lighter than it is, and small payments can pile up faster than expected.
segments.tr: Ini juga bisa membuat pengeluaran terasa lebih ringan daripada yang sebenarnya, dan pembayaran kecil bisa menumpuk lebih cepat dari yang diharapkan.

segments.src: As adoption grows and late payments draw attention, the sensible approach for shoppers is the same as with any credit: know what you owe, know when it is due, and make sure it fits the budget well beyond the holiday season.
segments.tr: Seiring pertumbuhan adopsi dan pembayaran terlambat menarik perhatian, pendekatan yang masuk akal bagi pembeli sama dengan kredit apa pun: ketahui apa yang Anda utang, ketahui kapan jatuh temponya, dan pastikan itu sesuai dengan anggaran jauh melampaui musim liburan.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk informasi umum dan bukan nasihat keuangan.

segments.tr: Ketentuan, biaya, dan peraturan bervariasi menurut penyedia dan lokasi.
